privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: DevSpeak is designed to work without collecting personal data. Here is exactly what happens with your information.
privacy.storageTitle: Your learning data stays on your device
privacy.storageBody: Your profile, progress, saved words and settings are stored locally in the app. They are not sent to any server. You can export, restore or delete them in Settings > Your data.
privacy.accountBody: You never need to sign up. The optional first name you enter is only used to greet you and never leaves the device.
privacy.microphoneBody: The microphone is used only when you tap Record in speaking practice. Recordings stay in the app cache on your device and are never uploaded.
privacy.analyticsBody: If you turn this on, anonymous events such as "lesson completed" help us improve the content. No name, email or contact details are collected. It is off by default.
privacy.adsBody: The free plan shows ads provided by Google AdMob. Google may use your device advertising ID according to your consent choices. Where required by law, we ask for your consent first, and you can change it in Settings.
privacy.purchasesBody: Subscriptions are processed by Google Play. Our subscription provider (RevenueCat) receives an anonymous app user ID and your purchase receipt to confirm Premium access. We never see your payment details.
privacy.rightsBody: You can delete all local data at any time. Uninstalling the app also removes it. Manage or cancel subscriptions in Google Play.
